theme.name: The Cartographer's Study
theme.description: A narrow study above a harbour office, smelling of ink and damp paper.

objects.name: writing desk
objects.description: A writing desk, its drawer hanging open.
objects.clueText: The open drawer holds a ledger, and nothing else worth the trouble.

objects.name: accounts ledger
objects.description: A leather ledger, swollen with damp.
objects.clueText: Columns of harbour dues. The final column totals 4471.

objects.name: wall safe
objects.description: A squat iron safe set into the plaster, with a four-digit keypad.
objects.clueText: The keypad takes four digits. The 7 is worn smooth.

objects.name: sea chart
objects.description: A rolled chart, edges furred with age.
objects.clueText: A chart of the coastal survey. The cartouche reads, in a careful hand, 1770.

objects.name: map cabinet
objects.description: A shallow map cabinet with a numbered dial.
objects.clueText: The dial runs 0000 to 9999. It turns stiffly.

objects.name: surveyor's logbook
objects.description: A slim logbook, every page ruled by hand.
objects.clueText: Every entry closes the same way: "departed, as always, to the north."

objects.name: studded door
objects.description: A studded oak door. It has no keyhole and no handle.
objects.clueText: No keyhole, no handle. Only a brass plate asking a question: which way out?

objects.name: shuttered window
objects.description: A window, shuttered and nailed fast.
objects.clueText: Nailed shut from the outside. Not the way.
